Face Painting League by MAGFACE

About the League

An online league for face painters. Artists from different countries compete in Games, grow their rating and build their own record of achievements.

Why a league

01

Grow

A new brief every round pushes you past familiar designs. Your rating shows how your level changes from Game to Game.

02

Compete with equals

The Bronze, Silver and Gold leagues group artists of a similar level. Beginners don't compete with pros.

03

Be seen

After the Game 01 final — an artist page with your rating, awards and League works (with your consent). Numbered certificates can be verified on the site.

The League grew out of marathons

For seven years MAGFACE ran face painting marathons: briefs, deadlines, work reviews and a large community of artists. Participants asked for more: fair comparison, meaningful awards and a history that lasts.

That's how the Face Painting League began: the same briefs and community, now with judges, a rating, leagues and seasons.

How the League works

Full details in the Rules
Season

Three Games and the Super Final

Game

A separate competition with its own prizes and results

Round

One brief, one deadline, scored by judges

Leagues

In Game 01 — League A and League B, set by round 1. From Game 02 — Bronze, Silver and Gold: the league is set by rating before the Game and does not change until it ends.

BronzeSilverGold

FPL Rating

Shows your current level. Changes after each round and takes the strength of opponents into account.

Points and awards

Medals, TOP WORK, trophies and FPL Points. Points add up and never expire: they're your history in the League.

Game 01 judges

Practising face painters and teachers of face painting and face art. Judges do not compete in the Games.
